title: Palm Oil EUDR Due-Diligence Readiness
thesis: Snowflake turns daily mill-intake activity from a fictional Indonesian palm oil supplier network into traceability-to-plot and flag-precision KPIs, 7-day canopy-loss risk scores, geolocation mismatch anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Traceability to plot, FFB deliveries, FFB intake and screening flag precision for 40 supply bases across 8 Indonesian mill-hub cities and 5 supplier types.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to supply-base-day rows.
The risk-signal chart shows which screening signals lead to confirmed canopy-loss cases and which mostly produce false-positive flags.
show: Daily FFB deliveries and screening flags
tabs.call_out: One governed set of traceability KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which supply bases should the field team visit first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each supply base's probability of a confirmed canopy-loss case in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags geolocation mismatch outliers per supply base, and the forecast projects network-wide FFB deliveries for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: Is the plot registry keeping up?

talking_points: Supplier declaration rate, plot geolocation coverage and geolocation checks still pending.
The scatter compares each supply base's declaration rate with its confirmed canopy-loss cases.
tabs.call_out: Find the gaps in plot geolocation before a buyer asks for it

transition.line: What happens when a delivery arrives without a matching plot?

talking_points: Mill-gate FFB delivery events land in RAW.LIVE_DELIVERIES: simulated in Snowflake, or from S3 through Snowpipe in the AWS build.
FLAG events (a delivery without a matching geolocated plot) are logged by the alert, which emails the team.
tabs.call_out: From mill gate to alert in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent answers with generated SQL over the semantic view and cites the synthetic traceability SOPs by ID.
The action memo is drafted only from KPI, supply base, risk-signal and risk rows; screening results are demo signals, not compliance verdicts.
show: Agent answer with SQL and SOP citations

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Both builds share the same core: seeded data, dynamic tables, Snowflake ML, Cortex Search, semantic view, agent, alert and task graph.
The AWS build adds S3 and Snowpipe ingestion, a Bedrock memo and a QuickSight dashboard with an Amazon Q topic.
